title: Teaching Assistant
details: Taught 150 students in auditorium sessions on the Odoo application across 4 modules, one session per week for one semester.
Helped students resolve application errors, handling an average of 3–4 case studies per session.

title: System Implementator
details: Managed and maintained retention of 54 travel agency clients through routine invoice billing and technical support for system usage.
Performed fixes and customizations on client website appearances using jQuery and CSS, completing display change requests for 2–3 clients per week.

title: Frontend Developer
details: Developed a multirole admin dashboard (5 access roles/levels) using React (Vite), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and TanStack Query to support merchant and driver verification and activation processes.
Optimized application performance through state management and data caching (TanStack Query), reducing data loading time to 41ms.
Designed and integrated APIs for the driver subscription renewal page using React, TanStack Query, and TanStack Router.
